convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 Parabolic SAR indicator (iSAR). Simple SAR-reversal entry/exit logic with fixed lot sizing and fixed SL/TP. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic. No custom indicators.

platform_context.has_digit_adjustment: true if SL/TP multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001

other_exits: SAR reversal closes opposite position before opening new one

custom_logic_notes: Classic Parabolic SAR reversal strategy: when SAR dots flip from above price to below price, go long; when SAR dots flip from below price to above price, go short. The SAR value on the previous bar is compared to price to detect the reversal. Opposite position is closed before new entry on reversal signal. SL/TP are in points and require digit-adjustment awareness (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers).
python_conversion_notes: SAR is available in ta-lib (SAR) and pandas-ta (psar). Signal detection: SAR flips when it transitions from above price to below price or vice versa. Compare sar_value vs low/high of previous completed bar. SL/TP values are in points; must convert to price units using point_value. New bar detection needed to prevent repeated signals within the same bar. Position check before entry prevents stacking. Use previous bar (shift=1) SAR and price values for signal to avoid repainting.
